products.name: Pro, monthly
products.description: Logs, serverless, cost history, more keys
products.review_note: Unlocks Pro: more than one API key, serverless containers, functions and jobs with their logs, instance logs, and the cost breakdown and history. Without Pro the app lists instances, starts and stops them, and shows this month's total cost. Use the demo (first screen or Settings) to see every feature without a Scaleway account.

products.name: Pro, yearly
products.description: Logs, serverless, cost history, more keys
products.review_note: The same Pro features as the monthly subscription, billed yearly. Use the demo (first screen or Settings) to see every feature without a Scaleway account.
